description: Use this when the user wants to adapt, tailor, customize, rewrite, polish, or optimize their resume for a specific job posting, or wants help applying to a role. Produces a downloadable, professionally-formatted PDF resume saved to the user's Career Adapter account, the content rewritten to match the posting's requirements.

defaultPrompt: I want to use career adapter to tailor my resume to a job description.
